answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The quill holds work receipts rather than names, so the spiral of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
